newsitem.title: SLOVENIA: Slovenian shares end flat, outlook murky.
newsitem.headline: Slovenian shares end flat, outlook murky.

text.p: Slovenian shares ended barely changed on poor turnover on Wednesday and traders said future market direction was difficult to gauge.

"The market is relatively optimistic due to a general expectation that foreign buying will resume in May, but investors are cautious -- being unable to say whether foreign interest will be large enough to support a rally," one trader said.
* The SBI index eased 0.46 points to 1,305.81.
* Overall seven shares fell, five rose and 15 were untraded.

* Issue A of drug producer Lek had the highest turnover, falling 0.73 percent to 24,600 tolars on volume of 622 shares for total turnover of 15.3 million tolars. -- Ljubljana newsroom, 386-61-125-8439
